ABC Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
 Employee Onboarding Document Requirements
1. Purpose
These guidelines define the documents and mandatory information required for employee onboarding
at ABC Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
2. Required Documents
The following documents are mandatory:
Aadhaar Card
Mandatory
PAN Card
Mandatory
Educational Qualification Document
Mandatory
Internship / Experience Certificate
Mandatory
Driving License
Mandatory
COVID-19 Vaccination Certificate
Mandatory
3. Aadhaar Card Requirements
Name — Required
Date of Birth — Required
Gender — Required
Aadhaar Number — Required
Address — Optional
4. PAN Card Requirements
Name — Required
Father's Name — Required
Date of Birth — Required
PAN Number — Required
5. Educational Qualification Document Requirements
Student / Applicant Name — Required
Date of Birth — Required
Institution / School — Required
Examination / Qualification Details — Required
Result / Marks — Required

6. Internship / Experience Certificate Requirements
Employee / Candidate Name — Required
Organization Name — Required
Internship / Employment Role — Required
Start Date — Required
End Date — Required
7. Driving License Requirements
Name — Required
Date of Birth — Required
Driving License Number — Required
License Validity — Required
8. COVID-19 Vaccination Certificate Requirements
Name — Required
Date of Birth — Required
Vaccination Status — Required
Vaccination Dose Details — Required
Certificate / Reference Number — Required
